summary: Comprehensive testing of checkout auth gate and SavedAddressPicker features (iteration 66). All 10 test scenarios pass. Backend GET /api/customer/saved-addresses endpoint working correctly with proper auth, empty array for no orders, and correct response shape. Frontend RFQAuthGate renders correctly for guests on both desktop and mobile checkout. Logged-in customers with complete profiles pass through gate and see auto-filled forms. SavedAddressPicker renders for customers with past orders and correctly fills form fields on chip click.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/customer/saved-addresses correctly dedupes on (address, pincode) and limits to 6 results
SavedAddressPicker correctly renders nothing when API returns empty array
RFQAuthGate profileComplete check correctly identifies incomplete profiles (name, email not placeholder, gstin)
CheckoutPageGated wrapper correctly wraps CheckoutPage with RFQAuthGate
MCheckout correctly wraps MCheckoutInner with RFQAuthGate using dense prop
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Used existing customer deepak.wadhwa@locofast.com who has past orders.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Checkout auth gate and SavedAddressPicker fully tested. Key localStorage keys: 'lf_customer_token' (JWT), 'lf_customer' (customer object). Profile completeness requires: name truthy, email NOT ending in '@phone.locofast.local', gstin truthy. SavedAddressPicker only renders when isLoggedIn AND GET /api/customer/saved-addresses returns non-empty array.

backend_saved_addresses_no_auth.details: GET /api/customer/saved-addresses with no auth header returns 401

backend_saved_addresses_no_orders.details: GET /api/customer/saved-addresses for customer with no orders returns empty array []

backend_saved_addresses_with_orders.details: GET /api/customer/saved-addresses for customer with orders returns up to 6 unique addresses with correct shape {name, company, phone, address, city, state, pincode, gst_number, last_used}

frontend_guest_desktop_checkout_gate.details: /checkout/?fabric_id=...&type=bulk&qty=2000 as guest shows RFQAuthGate with WhatsApp OTP entry, checkout form NOT visible

frontend_guest_mobile_checkout_gate.details: /m/checkout?fabric=...&type=bulk&qty=2000 as guest shows RFQAuthGate with 'Sign in to place this order' header

frontend_logged_in_checkout_autofill.details: Logged-in customer with complete profile passes through gate, shipping form auto-filled with name, phone, email, GST

frontend_saved_address_picker_with_order.details: SavedAddressPicker renders for customer with past orders, clicking chip fills form fields (Street, City, State, Pincode)

frontend_saved_address_picker_no_orders.details: SavedAddressPicker NOT rendered for customer without past orders

frontend_shared_cart_regression.details: /shared-cart/<token> loads and shows 'Cart Unavailable' for invalid token

frontend_rfq_no_checkout_copy_bleed.details: /rfq shows 'Sign in to request a quote' (not checkout-specific 'Sign in to place this order')

frontend_checkout_buttons_regression.details: Pay Now (Razorpay) and Apply for Credit buttons render once form is filled
